output.content: I keep a single spreadsheet open on my desktop during every training run. When a new model finishes, I add a row with the timestamp, the hyperparameters, and the validation accuracy. I manually copy the model file path from the terminal into the next cell. There is no API call or automated hook. I check the sheet before every deployment to confirm which version is current. It takes me about four minutes to update the file and verify the entries. I do this for every experiment, regardless of size.
